title: 第2章 夏老师，你这病，得治！
content_zh:
皖中一中是个花园式学校，环境清幽，风景优美，不过站在教室门外的叶寒却没什么心思欣赏，他目光遥遥望向远方天际，脑中回想着自己的前世今生，心中忽喜忽愁。

愁的是，自己现在这个身体实在孱弱，基本上跟一个废人没什么区别，想要恢复到昔日纵横一方的实力，一切只能重头再来；喜的是，自己生前所学的修炼法门以及一身神奇医术，都还清晰印在脑中，而且这个身体也还年轻，筋骨资质都算是上上之选，只要勤苦修炼、持之以恒，应该能收到事半功倍的效果。

在叶寒以前的那个修真世界里，人们极度崇尚实力，强者有尊严，弱者被奴役，叶寒深信现在自己所处的这个世界，也必然存在着弱肉强食的现象，所以想要不受欺负，想要获得尊重，只有尽快让自己变的强大起来。

教室内，夏紫萱清脆动听的讲课声不时传出，叶寒收起心神，侧耳用心去听，终于确定那冷艳女人果真是师长的身份。

想想刚才自己的怪异表现把夏紫萱激怒的情形，叶寒不由摇头苦笑，不过转念又想那也怪不得自己，一个人在得知自己大难不死、夺舍重生后，没有一点特殊反应才叫怪事。

下课铃声敲响后，初三（二）班的学生们从教室里蜂拥而出，每个人经过站在门口的叶寒身边时，都会偷偷冲他翘起大拇指，然后低低的说一些“你强”、“你牛”、“你有种”之类的话。

看着同学们崇拜的表情，叶寒并没有一点得意的样子，因为他的眼角余光已经发现夏紫萱正站在教室里的讲台上冷冷看着自己，如果自己表现出一副嚣张模样，天知道她会怎样惩罚自己。

“叶寒，跟我到办公室去一趟！”等学生们走光之后，夏紫萱寒着脸出现在叶寒面前，冷冷说道，她平时习惯把教案抱在胸前，却不知这样一来，本就饱满的胸脯被挤的更加显眼，饱了很多人的眼福。

叶寒只向她胸部瞟了一眼，就赶紧把目光移开，心想非礼勿视也，这位脾气很大的冷艳美女现在还在火头上，要是被她发现自己偷瞄她的胸前禁地，后果绝对不堪设想。

叶寒天生是个风流种子，前世在“仙医门”时，勾搭师姐、调戏师妹的事情他就没少干，如今灵魂夺舍重生，也别想他会老老实实，去办公室的一路上，他亦步亦趋的跟随在夏紫萱身后，从背后欣赏着这位冷艳老师韵律摆动的浑圆翘挺美臀，心里啧啧赞叹，暗想这位老师不但容貌极美，还有一副利于生养的好身材，实属难得。

到了自己办公室里，夏紫萱坐在办公桌前，低头开始整理手中的教案，眼皮也不抬一下，仿佛把叶寒当成了空气一般。

“姑娘……哦不，夏老师，你叫我来有什么事吗？”夏紫萱不出声，叶寒却站不住了，挠头问道。

夏紫萱这才抬头看了他一眼，哼了一声，坐直身体，冷然道：“叶寒，今天在教室里，你表现的很威风嘛！怎么样？出风头的感觉是不是很爽？”

叶寒明白这位美女老师还没消气，于是耸拉着脑袋，装出一副谦虚受教的样子，老老实实的道：“夏老师，我知道错了，你处罚我吧！”

叶寒前世阅人无数，察言观色之下，看出夏紫萱是个外冷内热、吃软不吃硬的女人，在她面前装英雄充好汉，只会死的更快，反而表现的越可怜越听话，她可能会既往不咎，放自己一马。

“刚才到底怎么回事？我想听听你的解释。”见叶寒服软认错，夏紫萱的脸色果然好看了一点，但声音依然是冷冰冰的，不带一丝感情。

叶寒叹了口气，道：“夏老师，是这样的……我趴在课桌上睡觉的时候，突然做了个恶梦……很可怕的恶梦……”

叶寒在来的路上就已经想好了应对之策，这时候也不管夏紫萱相不相信，反正就是一通乱扯。

“停停停！”夏紫萱不等他说完，就摆手打断了他的话头，揉了揉太阳穴，皱眉道：“好了，我相信你说的！”

夏紫萱是真的相信了叶寒，在她想来，以叶寒的怯弱性格，就算借他几个胆子，只怕他也不敢和自己顶撞。

“叶寒啊叶寒，你说你……你什么时候才能有个学生模样？你什么时候才能让你的父母放心？就算你不为自己想想，也要为自己的父母想想是不是？为了供你读书，你父母起早贪黑的去摆摊卖小吃，你要是有一点点良心的话，就该好好学习，报答他们……”

叶寒听她声音越来越大，口气越来越严厉，谆谆教诲，溢于言表，心想这位美女老师虽然脾气大了一点，却是个性情中人，这一点倒是令人敬佩。

听夏紫萱说完，叶寒神色一正，肃色道：“夏老师，我向你保证，从明天开始，我一定好好学习，做个让老师放心、让父母放心的好学生！夏老师，今后看我的表现吧！”

最后这几句话，以前叶寒是无论如何也说不出来的，而且在他那一双黑白分明的眼睛里，夏紫萱也看到了一种叫做真诚的东西，她点点头，目光中有了一丝暖意，道：“好吧，看在你真心认错的份上，今天我就不追究你的责任了！回家去吧，希望你能记住你自己今天说过的话，以后好好学习，不要再让我、让你的父母失望！”

看来自己的一番表态没有白废，这位美女老师果然心软放过了自己，叶寒暗暗松了口气，再次给夏紫萱鞠了一躬。

他正要转身离开，忽然间心中一动，目光凝注在夏紫萱脸上，低声道：“夏老师，那个……你最近是不是经常面红唇干、心烦口渴、气短乏力，小腹……偶尔会有绞痛感？”

夏紫萱一怔，脱口问道：“你怎么知道？”

废话，本人“仙医门”首席大弟子，以医入道，差一点就飞升成仙，要是连这个也看不出来，那还混个屁啊！

叶寒神秘一笑，道：“我是从你的脸色神情上判断出的……咳，我以前跟随一位老中医学过些医术，不说精通吧，但也马马虎虎。夏老师，你这是天癸紊乱之症……你这病，得治！”

夏紫萱不是个懵懂少女，兼之博学多才，自然知道叶寒口中所说的“天癸”是什么意思，俏脸“腾”地一下红了起来，猛地一拍桌面，怒道：“小屁孩儿懂什么？快滚！”

叶寒见她发火，不由愕然，随即明白“天癸”、“月事”之症，涉及到女人的隐私，当着她的面说出来确实不太合适，只好摊手耸肩，在夏紫萱的怒目注视中苦笑着走出办公室。

“小小年纪，就知道研究这些东西，难怪学不好！”

看着叶寒的背影在眼前消失，夏紫萱怒气还没消退，起身做了几个深呼吸，过去倒了杯茶水，随手拿过一份教材认真看了起来。

没过多久，小腹处忽然一阵绞痛，夏紫萱额头冒汗，神色痛苦，喃喃道：“该死，又疼了……都怪叶寒那个乌鸦嘴！唉，这毛病总是治不好，真折磨人！”

她把教材放到一边，拿起背包，急匆匆的向着附近一家医院奔去。

content_en:
Anhui No. 1 Middle School is a garden-style school with a quiet environment and beautiful scenery. However, Ye Han, who was standing outside the classroom door, had no intention of admiring it. He looked far away into the sky, recalling his past and present lives in his mind, feeling happy and sad at times.

What is worrying is that my current body is really weak, basically no different from a disabled person. If I want to regain my former strength, I have to start all over again. Fortunately, the cultivation methods and magical medical skills I learned during my lifetime are still clearly imprinted in my mind. Moreover, my body is still young, and my physical and mental aptitudes are considered to be the best. As long as I practice hard and persevere, I should be able to get twice the result with half the effort.

In the world of cultivation before Ye Han, people highly valued strength, the strong had dignity, and the weak were enslaved. Ye Han firmly believed that in the world he was in now, the law of the jungle must exist, so if he wanted not to be bullied and to gain respect, he had to become stronger as soon as possible.

In the classroom, Xia Zixuan's clear and melodious lectures could be heard from time to time. Ye Han put away his mind, listened attentively, and finally confirmed that the cold and charming woman was indeed his teacher.

Thinking about how his weird performance angered Xia Zixuan just now, Ye Han couldn't help but shake his head and smile bitterly, but then he thought that he couldn't blame himself. It was strange that a person didn't have any special reaction after learning that he had survived the disaster and was reborn.

After the bell rang, students from the third (second) class of junior high school poured out of the classroom. When everyone passed by Ye Han, who was standing at the door, they would secretly raise their thumbs at him, and then say something like "you are strong", "you are awesome", "you have talent" in a low voice.

Looking at the adoring expressions of his classmates, Ye Han didn't look proud at all, because out of the corner of his eye, he spotted Xia Zixuan standing on the podium in the classroom and looking at him coldly. If he showed an arrogant look, God knows how she would punish him.

"Ye Han, come to the office with me!" After all the students were gone, Xia Zixuan appeared in front of Ye Han with a cold face and said coldly. She usually hugged the lesson plans to her chest, but she didn't know that in this way, her already full breasts were squeezed into more conspicuousness, which attracted the attention of many people.

Ye Han only glanced at her breasts and then quickly looked away, thinking that it would be inappropriate to look at anything inappropriate. This cold-tempered beauty was still angry. If she caught him peeking at the forbidden area on her chest, the consequences would be absolutely disastrous.

Ye Han was born to be a romantic. When he was in the "Fairy Doctor Sect" in his previous life, he often flirted with and teased his senior sisters. Now that his soul has been reborn, there is no expectation that he will be honest. On the way to the office, he followed suit.He followed behind Xia Zixuan, admiring the round and beautiful buttocks of this cold and charming teacher from behind, admiring her heart. She secretly thought that this teacher was not only extremely beautiful, but also had a good figure that was conducive to fertility, which was really rare.

When she arrived in her office, Xia Zixuan sat at her desk, lowered her head and began to organize the lesson plans in her hands without raising her eyelids, as if she regarded Ye Han as air.

"Girl... oh no, Teacher Xia, why did you call me here?" Xia Zixuan remained silent, but Ye Han couldn't stand anymore and scratched his head and asked.

Xia Zixuan then raised her head and glanced at him, snorted, sat up straight, and said coldly: "Ye Han, you acted very majestic in the classroom today! How do you feel? Doesn't it feel good to be in the limelight?"

Ye Han understood that this beautiful teacher was still angry, so he shrugged his head, pretended to be humble and teachable, and said honestly: "Teacher Xia, I know I was wrong, please punish me!"

Ye Han had read countless people in his previous life, and after observing their words, he realized that Xia Zixuan was a woman who was cold on the outside and hot on the inside, who was soft-hearted but not hard-hearted. Pretending to be a hero in front of her would only lead to a faster death. On the contrary, the more pitiful and obedient she acted, she might forget about it and let herself go.

"What happened just now? I want to hear your explanation." Seeing Ye Han admit his mistake, Xia Zixuan's face looked better, but her voice was still cold and without any emotion.

Ye Han sighed and said, "Teacher Xia, it's like this... When I was sleeping on the desk, I suddenly had a nightmare... a very scary nightmare..."

Ye Han had already thought of a countermeasure on the way here. At this time, it didn't matter whether Xia Zixuan believed it or not, it was just nonsense anyway.

"Stop, stop, stop!" Xia Zixuan didn't wait for him to finish, she waved her hand to interrupt him, rubbed her temples, frowned and said, "Okay, I believe what you said!"

Xia Zixuan really believed Ye Han. When she thought about it, with Ye Han's timid character, even if he borrowed some courage, he would not dare to contradict her.

"Ye Han, Ye Han, you said you... when will you be able to look like a student? When will you be able to reassure your parents? Even if you don't think about yourself, you should think about your parents, right? In order to support your education, your parents worked from dawn to dusk to set up stalls and sell snacks. If you have any conscience, you should study hard and repay them..."

Ye Han listened to her voice getting louder and louder, her tone getting more and more stern, her teachings eloquent, and he thought to himself that although this beautiful teacher had a bit of a temper, she was a sweet-tempered person, which was quite admirable.

After hearing what Xia Zixuan said, Ye Han straightened up and said solemnly: "Teacher Xia, I promise you that starting from tomorrow, I will study hard and be a good student who can reassure teachers and parents! Teacher Xia, look at my performance from now on!"

Ye Han could not say these last few words before, and in his black and white eyes, Xia Zixuan also saw something called sincerity. She nodded, with a hint of warmth in her eyes, and said: "Okay, for the sake of sincerely admitting your mistake, I will not hold you accountable today! Go home, I hope you can remember what you said today, study hard in the future, and don't let me or your parents down again!"

It seemed that his words were not in vain. The beautiful teacher really softened his heart and let him go. Ye Han secretly breathed a sigh of relief and bowed to Xia Zixuan again.

He was about to turn around and leave when suddenly something moved in his heart. He focused his eyes on Xia Zixuan's face and whispered: "Teacher Xia, um...have you been feeling red and dry recently, feeling upset and thirsty, short of breath and weak, and occasionally have cramping in your lower abdomen?"

Xia Zixuan was startled and blurted out: "How do you know?"

Nonsense, I am the chief disciple of the "Immortal Medicine Sect". I entered Taoism through medicine and almost became an immortal. If you can't even see this, then you are a fool!

Ye Han smiled mysteriously and said: "I judged it from your face and expression... Well, I used to practice some medical skills with an old Chinese medicine practitioner. I am not proficient in it, but I am only sloppy. Teacher Xia, you have Tiangui disorder... Your disease needs to be cured!"

Xia Zixuan was not an ignorant girl. She was also knowledgeable and talented. Naturally, she knew what "Tiangui" in Ye Han's mouth meant. Her pretty face suddenly turned red. She slammed the table and said angrily: "What do you know, little brat? Get out of here!"

Ye Han couldn't help being shocked when he saw her getting angry, but then he understood that "Tiangui" and "menstruation" diseases involved women's privacy, and it was really inappropriate to say it in front of her, so he had to spread his hands and shrug, and walked out of the office with a wry smile under Xia Zixuan's angry gaze.

"You know how to study these things at a young age, no wonder you can't learn them well!"

Seeing Ye Han's back disappear in front of her eyes, Xia Zixuan's anger had not subsided. She stood up and took a few deep breaths, poured a cup of tea, picked up a textbook and read it carefully.

Not long after, there was a sudden cramping in her lower abdomen. Xia Zixuan sweated on her forehead and looked painful. She murmured: "Damn it, it hurts again... It's all because of Ye Han's crow mouth! Alas, this problem can never be cured, it's really tormenting!"

She put the textbook aside, picked up her backpack, and hurried to a nearby hospital.
